tools.name: next_holidays
tools.description: FREE. Next 3 US federal holidays (with observed dates) and whether today is a business day.

tools.name: business_days
tools.description: PRO. Count US business days between two dates (excludes weekends and federal holidays).

tools.name: due_date
tools.description: PRO. Due date after N business days or N calendar days (rolled to next business day) — Net 30/60, ACH settlement, contract notice periods.

tools.name: irs_deadlines
tools.description: PRO. Upcoming IRS filing and payment deadlines for the next N months (individual, payroll, corporate), adjusted for weekends/holidays; optional fiscal_year_end.

tools.name: domain_age
tools.description: FREE. Domain trust quick check: registration date, age in days, registrar, expiry and risk flags from RDAP. Accepts a domain or URL.

tools.name: domain_trust_report
tools.description: Full domain/URL trust report: RDAP registration, registrar, status, nameservers, plus active TLS certificates and issuers from crt.sh, with risk flags.

tools.name: cert_history
tools.description: Active TLS certificates for a domain from Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh): issuers, names, validity dates.

tools.name: email_domain_check
tools.description: Email/domain deliverability check: MX records, SPF and DMARC policy for a domain or email address (DNS over HTTPS).

tools.name: iban_validate
tools.description: FREE. Validate an IBAN offline: country, length and ISO 13616 mod-97 checksum, plus bank code and formatted IBAN. No outside source.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: domain_age, email_domain_check · Private data: email_domain_check · Public sink: email_domain_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: domain_age, email_domain_check · Private data: email_domain_check · Public sink: email_domain_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
